delivery.limits: Single fresh-profile sample with within-visit cache enabled; semantic first-frame proxy and rAF, not FCP/LCP or direct presentation rate; no stable speed-improvement claim.

verification.review_artifact_note: The PNG and WebP committed under .agents/docs/media are byte copies of the final real test outputs, not retouched illustrations.

resolved_findings: Pixelate size=1 logical is not identity at high DPI. Added independent amount and exact zero bypass. UI drops only its own identity filter wrapper; explicit renderer groups retain opacity/blend semantics.
Viewport clipping omitted input grid neighbourhood. Shared input_radius is independent of output reach; full-image vs crop equality now passes at 1/1.25/2 DPI.
Duration-only UI effect silently animated only progress. Named scalar channels now use public hanim PreparedEffects; wrong names/types/ranges are diagnosed.
Disabled nodes suppressed appearance material together with feedback. Explicit appearance usage retains base material and excludes interactive variants.
TOML bool conversion accepted integer 1. Strict is_boolean is required for reverse.
Wasm32/native64 raw size_t display hash differed with equal pixels. Explicit-width little-endian shared hash encoding preserves native golden and now matches Wasm.

Keeping a zero-strength UI wrapper reapplied antialiased ancestor clips and changed 514 pixels of the existing glass reference. Omitting the redundant wrapper restores the original PNG without changing its golden.
Browser semantic checks passed while parameter sliders had no visible captions. Real screenshot review led to explicit names/current values/units and five more browser assertions.
Transparent test exports could be misread by viewers. The real test renderer now uses a declared opaque background, recorded in sampling provenance.
An initial generated host-build cache lock lacked entries. Bootstrapped only generated workspace metadata; parent final build uses --locked and source lock bytes stay unchanged.
Default headless GPU discovery lacked a device. Required SDL offscreen Vulkan lavapipe verifies real execution instead of accepting skipped GPU tests.
